answer: For agents trading onyx, quartz and velvet, give each independently verified person one anonymous membership credential. To vote, an agent proves possession and derives a nullifier from that credential and the ballot ID. Validators reject a reused nullifier, so copying one credential across a thousand keys still yields one vote. Extra votes require recruiting additional verified people, raising the farm's cost. Independent issuer audits limit duplicate issuance; credential rental and issuer collusion remain weaknesses.
